protocol: every executable protocol bound to R3 or catalog v2
every protocol schema that omits DOCUMENTARY or its required PARTIAL status_max
every protocol fixture that embeds the v2 catalog hash
executable_attacks: all records, subjects, configs, manifests and hashes derived from an invalidated protocol
P02 documentation-only control and every subject derived from its previous unsatisfiable binding
any mutation whose expected semantics depend on the R3 role set or v2 accepted evidence rules
oracles: all calibrations, corpora, fixtures, evaluators, suites and protected manifests that read or encode R3 or v2
all oracle prompts, coverage matrices and authorship records causally bound to those inputs
every P02 expectation must be regenerated independently from R4 without reading attacks or candidate
derived_results: all discriminatory results, replays, diagnostics, receipts and seals derived from invalidated inputs
any future candidate started before a complete R4 v3 discriminatory seal

restart_requirements: regenerate protocol under segregated verifier authority from the final R4 and v3 hashes
regenerate affected executable attacks under segregated adversary authority
regenerate oracle artifacts under segregated oracle authority without candidate or attack access
rerun the complete positive, negative and opaque gate
